design_gotchas.title: CRITICAL Dual-Silicon Transition (New CMOS vs. Legacy Bipolar) Under Same OPN
design_gotchas.detail: Per SLVS561O (p.1, p.5, p.8, p.29), TLV1117-33IDCYR can ship with either Legacy silicon (CSO: SFB — 5 mA IQ, 1.2 V dropout, requires 10 uF tantalum with 0.2–10 ohm ESR, 104.3°C/W RθJA) or New silicon (CSO: RFB/FFAB — 65 uA IQ, 0.8 V dropout, ceramic-cap stable 2–500 mOhm ESR, internal soft-start & 250 mA foldback short-circuit limit). Check reel CSO labels and design COUT/ESR safely if dual-fab inventory is possible!

design_gotchas.title: Mutually Narrow ESR Overlap Between Legacy (0.2–10 Ohm) and New Chip (0.002–0.5 Ohm)
design_gotchas.detail: Notice that Legacy silicon requires ESR >= 0.2 ohm while New fixed-output silicon caps ESR at <= 0.5 ohm (p.1, p.5)! If a PCB must accept mixed legacy and new TLV1117-33IDCYR reels without oscillation, COUT ESR must land strictly inside the narrow 0.2–0.5 ohm overlap window (e.g., 10 uF low-ESR polymer-tantalum).

design_gotchas.title: Lower 16 V Absolute Maximum VIN vs. 20 V on LM1117 / NCP1117
design_gotchas.detail: TLV1117 Absolute Maximum VIN is strictly 16 V (p.4), leaving only 1 V margin above the 15 V operating max—significantly tighter than TI LM1117 and onsemi NCP1117 (both 20 V abs max). Protect 12 V rails against inductive overshoot or surges > 16 V.

design_gotchas.title: No Reverse-Current Protection & Standard 1117 VOUT Thermal Tab
design_gotchas.detail: Section 7.1.3 (p.23) requires an external Schottky diode from VOUT to VIN if VOUT can exceed VIN + 0.3 V. As with all standard 1117 SOT-223 parts, Pin 4 (tab) is tied to VOUT (Pin 2, p.3), never GND.

typical_use_cases: Modernized low-IQ (65 uA on new chip) & ceramic-stable candidate drop-in upgrade on legacy 1117 SOT-223 boards
Industrial (-40°C to +125°C) 5 V-to-3.3 V up-to-800 mA rails benefiting from 0.8 V dropout on new silicon
Space-saving 1117 designs migrating from bulky tantalum to 1–10 uF MLCCs (once verified on RFB/FFAB new-chip reels)
General-purpose 5 V or regulated 12 V bus post-regulation with <= 15 V steady-state input
engineering_summary: The TI TLV1117-33IDCYR is an industrial (-40°C to +125°C) 800 mA SOT-223-3 (DCY) regulator with classic 1117 pinout (1=GND, 2/Tab=VOUT, 3=VIN) undergoing TI's major silicon modernization (SLVS561O): new silicon (CSO: RFB/FFAB) slashes IQ to 65 uA, drops VDO to 800 mV, and supports ceramic caps (2–500 mOhm ESR), while legacy silicon (CSO: SFB) remains a 5 mA bipolar part requiring 0.2–10 ohm tantalum. Engineers using it as a candidate drop-in must verify reel CSO fab codes, ESR overlap (0.2–0.5 ohm if mixed), and the tight 16 V abs-max VIN ceiling before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.3 confirmed DCY SOT-223 Top View pinout (1=ADJ/GND, 2=OUTPUT, 3=INPUT) and Tab (Pin 4) tied to OUTPUT (VOUT).

300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.5-6 confirmed Recommended Operating Conditions (4.7-15 V, 800 mA, TJ=-40 to 125°C), new-chip fixed-output ESR window (0.002-0.5 ohm), and DCY RθJA (95.4°C/W new vs 104.3°C/W legacy).
Documented critical New Chip (65 uA IQ, 800 mV dropout, ceramic-stable) vs Legacy Chip (5 mA IQ, 1200 mV dropout, 0.2-10 ohm tantalum) dual-silicon transition from p.1, p.8, and p.29.
